_source: Codex CLI UserPromptSubmit hook payload, transcribed from openai/codex's generated hook-payload JSON schemas as cited in docs/adr/0004-agent-adapter-contract.md — session_id, cwd, prompt, model, turn_id, permission_mode, hook_event_name, transcript_path (+ optional agent_id/agent_type). Uses the SAME session_id/cwd/prompt as ../claude-code/user-prompt-submit.json on purpose (see crates/cli/tests/agent_contract_v2.rs's cross-agent equivalence test).
